tiers.name: Wood Tier
benefits: Use of tables and gaming area

tiers.name: Platinum Tier
benefits: Free access to all association facilities
4 Free reservations of the D&D table (no time limit)
Highest priority in all preorders & events

rules.eligibility: Benefits require last 3 consecutive months of valid membership
rules.upgrading: Upgrading tiers requires paying the difference for the last 3 months without receiving benefits during that period
rules.abuse: Any abuse of benefits may result in tier revocation and association ban
rules.priority: Higher tier members have priority in event registration and preorders, but priority does not guarantee full allocation. Quantity may be limited if a member does not attend the minimum number of tournaments for that game
rules.creditUsage: Credit can be used for tournaments and bar items only during the year. Credit rolls over monthly and expires December 31st; it does not carry into the next year
rules.materialsCredit: Credit cannot be used for materials during the year, except leftover credit at year-end (by December 31st). Extra rules will be applied.

priorityExample.description: If a Wood member orders 1 box and a Bronze member orders 2 boxes, but only 2 boxes are available, the Bronze member receives their full order first due to tier priority, provided they attend tournaments for that game. If they don't meet the tournament attendance minimum, their allocation may be reduced.
